title: Audit CSV export, streamed
caption: The link is a plain <a> (never next/link, whose prefetch would run the export and write its audit row). The handler streams the API's body without buffering; HEAD answers 405. Code: (app)/audit/export.csv/route.ts, (app)/audit/audit-filters.ts.

steps.label: Download CSV (tenantId, actorType, action, … from=YYYY-MM-DD, to=YYYY-MM-DD)
validate like the page; period set and ≤ 1 calendar year, else 400 text/plain
SELECT ≤ 100 000 rows newest first; INSERT audit.exported
stream: text/csv; Content-Disposition velexis-audit-<from>-<day after to>.csv; Cache-Control no-store
steps.note: A failure mid-stream aborts the download; an ended session → /sign-in?next=/audit?<filters>
